summary: On January 31 and February 1, 2018, City Council adopted an interim process for the selection of Tenant Directors to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation board for a two-year term, consistent with the City's current Public Appointments Policy. City Council, tenants and a number of stakeholders had called for an updated process to elect and appoint tenants to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors (reference: CC7.12). These calls included feedback received by Toronto Community Housing Corporation through their tenant engagement processes and by the City through the Tenants First project. The adopted process is as follows: the City and Toronto Community Housing Corporation to conduct outreach and promotion to Toronto Community Housing Corporation tenants inviting applications for appointment to the Board of Directors; Toronto Community Housing Corporation and City staff will hold information sessions for tenants interested in applying to be appointed to the Board of Directors, promoting the opportunity and highlighting the City's Public Appointments portal; as per the Public Appointments process, the City Clerk's Office will take in applications and screen candidates for eligibility; and a selection panel composed of two City staff and a Toronto Community Housing Corporation tenant appointed by the Deputy City Manager, Cluster A, will shortlist,…
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the interim Toronto Community Housing Corporation Tenant Director appointment process to allow a subcommittee of the Tenants First Tenant Advisory Panel to review the Tenant Director applications and provide their feedback to the selection panel to inform the selection of applicants for interviews.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the interim Toronto Community Housing Corporation Tenant Director appointment process to allow a subcommittee of the Tenants First Tenant Advisory Panel to review the Tenant Director applications and provide their feedback to the selection panel to inform the selection of applicants for interviews.
